reviews.title: Good for little kids
reviews.text: This app makes me more anxious. Everything starts out with breathing, which for me is not a good thing and then the meditations themselves are more appropriate for a child than an adult. Also, I don’t like the voices, kind of cold and distant. It feels very patronizing to even listen to these meditations.

reviews.text: why do all these companys charge money for time and more understanding about god i find so many cool seeming apps n then most if not all of it is behind a paywall
It’s sad another app that advertises as being free then after you download it everything has a lock on it.

reviews.title: This app is DEMONIC! DO NOT USE!
reviews.text: Praise God for His discernment! When you download the app, it automatically makes you touch some weird meditation circle (not biblical), so that right there threw me off! I made sure to do my research & sure enough, so many people were complaining that they were getting nightmares & convicted to not listen to this app anymore. Do your research & youll find many people complaining about this about this app. I definitely do not recommend this! Instead, use The Bible. That is all we really need.

reviews.title: Beware of trial
reviews.text: No notification of trial end. Ok content.

reviews.title: No More Children’s Stories
reviews.text: Abide has halted all their children’s stories, the reason we bought a subscription. While Skyship Dreamer was great, Abide has not nor plans to release any new content indefinitely. We weee so bummed about this decision and have been listening to the same stories for a few years now.

reviews.title: Illegal charges.
reviews.text: I signed up for the free 7 day trial. The app stated I’d be charged $39.99 on September 4th for the subscription if I didn’t cancel. It is September 3rd and I’ve already been charged. Haven’t even made it to the full 7 days. That isn’t honorable or moral for a “Christian” app. I will never renew my subscription just for that. The app cannot be trusted.

reviews.title: Grifting off spirituality - terrible marketing emails.
reviews.text:
I received an email from this company to renew my annual subscription, the subject line said “Your SOUL deserves 40% off”
it felt absolutely disgusting and i canceled my subscription. There are better apps out there that are free. My “soul” needs Jesus not discounts.

reviews.title: So incredibly didrespectful
reviews.text:
The app gives you an opportunity to set the amount of time you want on your devotional. 5 minutes. 10 minutes. 15 minutes. 20 minutes. Etc.

If you set the app for five minutes, frequently it will go 7 1/2 or eight minutes. It really does not care what you are trying to do and how much time you have. They will go with what they want to do. Kind of like a preacher who runs Long every single Sunday by 20 minutes because “the spirit led him“. That’s great, but this is an app that’s specific to settings for length.

It’s extremely disrespectful to the users time. They can edit it down and do a hard cut off at the designated time. Or at least within 5 to 10 seconds of it.

If you do it daily, this happens at least 3 to 4 days a week, so it’s not an isolated situation.
